description: Minimum interactive target sizes per WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 and common platform conventions.

exceptions.description: Targets inline with body text (text links, inline buttons in a paragraph).
exceptions.rule: Exempt — inline text links do not need 24px hit area.

exceptions.description: Targets with ≥24px center-to-center spacing between adjacent interactive elements.
exceptions.rule: Smaller targets permitted if every adjacent interactive center is ≥24px away.

exceptions.description: Native form controls styled by the UA.
exceptions.rule: UA defaults exempt; custom-styled controls fall back under the rule.

exceptions.description: Targets where larger size would essentially change the presentation (e.g., interactive maps).

apple-hig.note: Apple Human Interface Guidelines. Stricter than WCAG 2.2. Prefer this on iOS/macOS.

material.note: Material Design. Stricter. Prefer this on Android.

web-default.note: WCAG 2.2 floor. Raise to 44 for touch-primary UIs.

padding.rule: Add padding inside the interactive element to reach 24×24. Works for buttons where the background is the hit area.

pseudo-element.rule: Use ::before with absolute positioning and negative inset to expand hit area without affecting visual layout.

rejected.margin: Margin does not count as hit area — it is space BETWEEN elements, not part of the target.
